messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cross-pillar stitch: role alignment & QBR readiness

Team — sharing the third pass of the cross-pillar stitch deck and the OKR alignment workbook. The goal: finalize the org / role callouts and the executive QBR narrative by EOD Tuesday so we can circulate to sales & legal ahead of the customer readout.

Top asks: 
- Please review slide 7 (role map) and confirm inbound/outbound ownership for the pieces marked as 'shared' — we need clear single-point-of-truth for oncall and PRs.
- Look at OKR tab named "QBR bridge" and add any missing metrics (owner column is blank for two rows).
- I plan to include a short script for the exec readout (slide 2). If you have phrasing objections, flag them now.

Attachments: restructure-slide-deck-v3.pptx (pptx, 3.1MB), okrs-2026-q3-stitch.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

I want to preserve the tone: constructive consolidation, minimal headcount disruption, explicit escalation paths. Comments inline in the deck are fine — but add a short note in the workbook when you change an owner so we can track.

Naomi
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-pillar stitch: role alignment & QBR readiness

Thanks Naomi — quick notes after a pass: 
1) Slide 7: for the runtime-infra overlap, recommend we assign primary to Platform (Marissa) and secondary to Serving (Mina) rather than the reverse. I'll add comments on the exact bullet that needs to flip.
2) "QBR bridge" tab: I added owners for the latency and throughput metrics (lines 4 & 5) — both flagged as "Platform". We should surface historical trend lines on slide 10 to justify the ask for burst capacity in Dedicated.
3) Customer comms: suggest we don't include the phrase "consolidation" in the external message — use "simplifying handoffs" instead.

I've left inline comments in the deck and updated the workbook. Small ask: Naomi, can you confirm whether the canary plan remains a 2-week window or whether we want a rolling 8-week phased approach? That affects messaging and the SLA exceptions table.

- Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-pillar stitch: role alignment & QBR readiness

Adding my edits and a short annex (attached) that maps current leads to proposed role templates. Key points: 
- I agree with Jonas on the Platform primary for runtime kernel work — I've updated slide 7 and noted the primary contact emails.
- Canary plan: propose a rolling 6-week window — three-week pilot on a small set of customers (10%) followed by an incremental expansion to 50% over the next three weeks. That gives us a shorter pilot than 8 weeks but more control than 2.
- I drafted a one-paragraph customer note (see draft-customer-comm.md attachment). For external audiences we lead with performance improvements and improved reliability; the operational changes are second.

Attachments: draft-customer-comm.md (text, 4KB)

If legal/finance weigh in on any of the suggested SLA exceptions, ping me and I'll adjust the rollout bullets.

Marissa
Director, Platform Strategy

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir@cumulushealth.com>

Subject: Fwd: Cross-pillar stitch: role alignment & QBR readiness

Forwarding finalized notes to Samir for visibility ahead of our customer QBR on 6/22. Samir — attached is the deck we'll use in the exec readout; highlights below and the script is on slide 2. We will not change any customer SLAs without explicit agreement from legal, but the canary rollout timing is within our control and designed to minimize disruption.

Highlights for Cumulus Health: 
- No immediate headcount changes; operational handoffs clarified to reduce ticket thrash.
- Planned pilot window (3 weeks) for a limited set of customers, then staged expansion — we'll only expand with telemetry confirming latency + error-rate stability.
- We welcome any constraints you need to surface (maintenance windows, blackout periods) so we can accommodate them in the pilot.

Attachment: restructure-slide-deck-v3.pptx

Naomi
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
